summary: Tuniu Corp filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its unaudited financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026. The release reports net revenues of RMB132.6 million ($19.2 million), a 12.8% year-over-year increase, and non-GAAP profitability for the fifth consecutive quarter. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer, with no deal terms or structural events. This filing does not qualify as a special situation.
